This notice serves as an initial announcement. It is not a solicitation for bids. The upcoming procurement will create a nationwide dynamic purchasing system for Finland, open to participation by submitting an application per the procurement notice. The dynamic purchasing system is divided into two parts: Part 1. Pavement radar measurements and/or pavement radar interpretations Part 2. Pavement drilling and/or taking pavement drill core samples The tasks will be competed among suppliers in the dynamic purchasing system, forming separate assignments for the Client. The scope of these assignments may vary, and their value depends on the yearly amount of new pavements and the confirmed budget. There is also a 14,000-kilometer backlog in pavement thickness data, measured within the annual budget. Tehtävään kuuluu alustavasti: - Päällysteiden poranäytteiden (kaikkien sidottujen kerrosten) ottaminen ja paksuuden mittaaminen, sekä poranäytteen kuvaaminen ja dokumentointi erillistoimeksiannossa annetussa aikataulussa -
